anchor_scope: atm-task-close.py dev and fix roles; atm-bd dispatch of sanity beads
anchor_statement: When a dev or fix bead closes, the group's sanity bead must be assigned to the dev-sanity member with the sanity template and vars without any lead action: by the dev's close hook in the same shell command as bd close, and by atm-bd when bd ready lists the sanity bead with no ATM task.

cases.text: The dev role of atm-task-close.py runs atm task assign atm-sanity --task-id <sanity bead> and bd close <dev bead> in one shell command; an atm-bd tick finds a ready sanity bead with no task and assigns it.
The lead reads the dev-complete report and runs atm task assign for the sanity bead by hand, or atm-bd only logs a notice that the sanity bead is ready.

When the fix role closes a fix bead it runs atm task assign <dev-sanity member> --task-id <sanity bead> --template sanity.xml.j2 --vars <file> and bd close <fix bead> in one shell command; separately, each atm-bd tick assigns the same way any sanity bead that bd ready lists with no ATM task. The lead does nothing.

cases.rationale: In-scope dev close, silent about sanity assignment.
cases.text: The dev role checks that the PR is open on pr_target before it runs bd close.
This item covers what happens when a dev bead closes.
After the dev reports complete, the lead assigns the sanity bead to dev-sanity.

cases.rationale: atm-bd must assign it (the fail fixture names this case).
cases.text: atm-bd posts a 'sanity ready' notice to the lead instead of assigning the ready sanity bead.
